title: Vault Graph Round 2 MCP·코딩 하네스 검증 및 릴리스 계획
description: 이미 구현된 Round 2 project-context 경로를 SPEC과 대조하고 전체 검증 게이트를 통과시킨 뒤 사용자 승인 범위에서만 커밋·릴리스하는 계획이다.

page.humanSummary: Round 2 구현과 SPEC을 맞추고, MCP·하네스·읽기 전용·prompt 감소 게이트를 검증한다.
page.agentSummary: ProjectContextService, explore_project, explicit harness guidance의 현재 구현을 contract와 대조하고 검증 증거를 고정한다. 커밋·메인 병합·원격 push는 별도 사용자 승인 없이는 수행하지 않는다.

body.goal: 코드와 Vault를 별도 권위로 유지하는 하나의 bounded explore_project 흐름을 Round 2 SPEC과 일치시키고, 재현 가능한 검증 결과와 사용자 제어 릴리스 경계를 남긴다.
body.architecture: ProjectContextService가 코드 projection/query, Vault context-pack/status, 관계와 freshness를 조합하는 deep module이다. MCP는 얇은 read-only adapter이고 harness guidance는 명시적으로 선택한 비-Vault instruction file에만 제한적으로 쓰인다.

workerInstructions.note: Stenc 0.4.1 plan validator와 기존 문서 호환성을 위해 두 legacy capability label을 보존한다. 이 저장소의 실제 실행에는 Superpowers workflow를 호출하지 않으며, 직접 검토·테스트·Stenc 검증으로 진행한다.

scopeCheck.assessment: Round 2 핵심 구현, SPEC의 실제 handoff 링크, focused benchmark와 전체 release gate가 현재 브랜치에 존재하고 통과했다. 후속 검토에서 발견된 canonical Data Home 기본값과 계획 상태 문구의 불일치를 이 유지보수 slice에서 정리하고 회귀 검증한다.
scopeCheck.decomposition: 계약 대조, 전체 검증, 검토 후 일관성 보정, 사용자 제어 릴리스 handoff의 네 단계로 나눈다. 소스 권위나 MCP 경계를 확장하지 않고 현재 구현의 증거만 고정한다.

body.currentState: ProjectContextService, explicit repository-to-Vault binding, explore_project MCP tool, reversible harness guidance, deterministic benchmark가 구현되어 있다. Round 2 SPEC은 approved 상태이고 실제 handoff plan과 연결되어 있으며, canonical Data Home 기본값과 계획 상태 문구의 검토 보정 및 재검증까지 완료되었다. 남은 단계는 사용자 제어 커밋·릴리스 결정뿐이다.
body.targetState: Round 2 SPEC과 구현이 일치하고 실제 plan·rendered page·검증 결과가 연결된다. 현재 브랜치는 커밋 후보로 준비되지만 메인 병합과 원격 push는 사용자 지시 전까지 보류한다.

in: Stenc 0.4.1 plan source 생성 및 rendered page 갱신
focused test, full suite, MCP stdio smoke, static, build, lock, diff 검증
검증 결과와 남은 사용자 승인 지점 기록
out: Vault 또는 등록 repository 내용 수정
새 parser, hosted service, LLM/network 의존성
원격 push, main 병합, release tag 생성

slices.title: SPEC과 구현 계약 대조

steps.title: Check authority and scope boundaries
steps.instruction: Confirm Vault and registered repository remain separate authorities, repository-to-Vault binding is explicit, source bodies and absolute paths are not serialized, and missing or stale evidence remains visible.

steps.title: Repair the Stenc handoff link
steps.instruction: Create the matching Stenc plan, add it to relatedPlans, and record the correction in PATCH_LOG without changing implementation behavior.

doneWhen: Every Round 2 source link resolves to a repository file
SPEC implementationHandoff points to an existing Stenc plan
No new source authority or write path is introduced

slices.title: Round 2 전체 검증 게이트

files.role: Prompt/tool orchestration and stale-result acceptance gate
Canonical JSON and generated fixed-format pages

steps.title: Run focused Round 2 tests
steps.command: uv run pytest tests/test_project_context_service.py tests/test_project_context_models.py tests/test_project_context_scope.py tests/test_project_context_budget.py tests/test_project_context_serialization.py tests/test_project_context_read_only_boundary.py tests/test_project_context_import_boundaries.py tests/test_project_binding_catalog.py tests/test_cli_project_binding.py tests/test_mcp_explore_project.py tests/test_mcp_explore_project_read_only_boundary.py tests/test_harness_guidance.py tests/test_harness_guidance_read_only.py tests/test_setup_harness_guidance.py tests/benchmarks/test_project_context_benchmark.py -q

steps.title: Run the release gate
steps.command: uv run pytest -q && VG_RUN_MCP_STDIO_SMOKE=1 uv run pytest tests/test_mcp_stdio_smoke.py -q && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src && uv build && uv lock --check && git diff --check
steps.expected: 1149 passed, 1 skipped; MCP stdio 1 passed; static checks, build, lock, and diff checks pass.

steps.title: Validate Stenc and rendered pages
steps.expected: Both canonical JSON documents validate and every rendered Stenc page passes the page and local-media checks.

steps.title: Close review consistency findings
steps.command: uv run pytest tests/test_code_repository_catalog.py -q && node ${CODEX_SKILLS_DIR:-$HOME/.codex/skills}/stenc/scripts/setup-project.js --project-root "$(pwd)" --docs-dir docs/stenc && node ${CODEX_SKILLS_DIR:-$HOME/.codex/skills}/stenc/scripts/validate-stenc-doc.js docs/stenc/content/plans/2026-08-04-vault-graph-round-2-mcp-coding-harness.plan.json && node ${CODEX_SKILLS_DIR:-$HOME/.codex/skills}/stenc/scripts/check-rendered-pages.js docs/stenc
steps.expected: Direct code-catalog construction resolves the canonical Graph Home, the approved plan no longer describes a draft or missing handoff, and regenerated Stenc pages pass validation.

doneWhen: MCP stdio smoke runs with the runtime enabled
Stenc source and rendered-page checks pass
Plan currentState matches the approved SPEC and existing handoff link

slices.title: 사용자 제어 릴리스 handoff

files.role: Confirm the exact reviewable change set

steps.title: Wait for explicit commit and merge direction
steps.instruction: Present the changed files and verification evidence. Commit only after the user explicitly requests it; do not merge to local main or push to remote as part of this plan.

doneWhen: The user has explicitly chosen whether to commit, merge, or release
No remote mutation occurs without that explicit instruction

risks.risk: A future parser or MCP change could make the verified contract stale.
risks.mitigation: Keep the SPEC, plan, focused acceptance tests, and full release gate in the same reviewable change set.

risks.risk: Generated Stenc pages could be mistaken for canonical documentation.
risks.mitigation: Treat the JSON files under docs/stenc/content as source and regenerate pages with Stenc 0.4.1.

risks.risk: A release action could mutate a branch or remote without user intent.
risks.mitigation: Keep commit, main merge, tag, and push outside the executed slices until explicitly requested.

validation.purpose: Confirm the complete local suite remains green without source-authority mutation.
Exercise the MCP stdio protocol gate with the local runtime enabled.

validation.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src && uv build && uv lock --check && git diff --check
validation.purpose: Verify style, formatting, static typing, packaging, lock consistency, and whitespace safety.
Verify both Stenc JSON sources and all generated fixed-format pages.

agentInstructions: Read docs/SPEC.md, docs/DESIGN.md, docs/FEATURES.md, and the linked Round 2 SPEC before changing behavior.
Keep ProjectContextService as the deep composition boundary; MCP and CLI remain thin adapters.
Keep Vault and registered repository content read-only and preserve visible freshness and scope warnings.
Use Stenc JSON as the documentation source and do not hand-edit generated pages.
Do not invoke Superpowers workflows or mutate local main or remote branches without explicit user instruction.
